subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372, including new config/API surface and fail-closed detached Slack paths, or keep the current per-workspace account model for now?
rationale: This adds operator config and changes Slack authorization and message-delivery boundaries; the issue also carries protected maintainer and security-review labels, so automation should not settle the product direction.

options.title: Review Linked PR As V1
options.body: Treat the open PR as the candidate implementation and require maintainer acceptance of the config, API, security, upgrade, and live-proof scope before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow The Scope First
options.body: Keep the issue open while revising the PR to reduce public hooks or unsupported fail-closed surfaces before accepting Enterprise Grid support.

options.title: Defer Enterprise Grid
options.body: Leave or close the direction only if maintainers decide org-wide Slack installs should wait for a broader workspace-scoped delivery design.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR As V1
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the candidate implementation and require maintainer acceptance of the config, API, security, upgrade, and live-proof scope before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main Slack admission/config history points to this person as the best available owner for the product-boundary decision.
